# Static cURL 8.23.0 with HTTP3

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Security rebuild of cURL 8.23.0 — please upgrade from `8.23.0` or `8.22.0`.**
>
> This release rebuilds cURL 8.23.0 with an updated embedded CA bundle from
> [curl.se](https://curl.se/ca/cacert.pem). The previous bundle trusted the
> **emSign ECC Root CA - G3** root (eMudhra, India), which Mozilla removed from
> NSS on 2026-10-20 after private keys of eight eMudhra intermediate CAs were
> found to be compromised. With those keys, anyone could issue certificates that
> the old bundle would accept for any domain.
>
> - curl version is unchanged; only the build (and changes merged since `8.23.0`) differ.
> - `--cacert` / `CURLOPT_CAINFO` users are not affected by the embedded bundle,
>   but should update their own CA files too.
> - Previous cacert.pem SHA256 (8.23.0): `a41b5d356aea97a529fe27e0f7316d2f9d946d75927476cf9cf1b90637d00505`

## Components

- libcurl/8.23.0
- OpenSSL/4.0.3
- zlib/1.3.1.zlib-ng
- brotli/1.2.1
- zstd/1.5.7
- c-ares/1.34.9
- libidn2/2.3.8
- libpsl/0.23.3
- libssh2/1.11.1
- nghttp2/1.70.0
- ngtcp2/1.25.0
- nghttp3/1.18.0

## Protocols

dict file ftp ftps gopher gophers http https imap imaps ipfs ipns mqtt mqtts pop3 pop3s rtsp scp sftp smtp smtps telnet tftp ws wss

## Features

alt-svc asyn-rr AsynchDNS brotli CAcert ECH HSTS HTTP2 HTTP3 HTTPS-proxy HTTPSIG HTTPSRR IDN IPv6 Largefile libz NTLM proxy-HTTP3 PSL SSL SSLS-EXPORT threadsafe UnixSockets zstd

## License

This binary includes various open-source software such as curl, openssl, zlib (or zlib-ng), brotli, zstd, libidn2, libssh2, nghttp2, ngtcp2, nghttp3. Their license information has been compiled and is included in the dev package.

## Build Info

Built by [GitHub Actions](https://github.com/stunnel/static-curl/actions/runs/39755264956)
